key_themes: AI semiconductor surge: Jensen Huang crowns Marvell next trillion-dollar chip company at Computex Week
Software earnings caution: Salesforce and Intuit sell off on cautious guidance and AI competitive threats
AI infrastructure capital race: Alphabet announces unprecedented $80B stock offering to fund AI buildout

stocks.reason: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang called Marvell the next trillion-dollar company at Computex Week in Taipei, citing its AI data center networking and optical interconnect solutions; stock surged ~32% in its biggest single-day gain ever
Q2 FY2026 earnings beat Wall Street estimates; company raised full-year earnings and revenue guidance, citing strong AI server demand; stock surged ~25% premarket
Beat quarterly earnings and raised full-year sales guidance to $7.03B-$7.13B from prior $6.85B-$6.95B; shares surged ~44% intraday on profit recovery and improved outlook
Reported Q3 FY2026 earnings after close: EPS of $0.85 beat $0.81 estimate; CEO cited accelerating AI security bookings; stock rose ~10% in after-hours trading

Goldman Sachs double-downgraded to Sell from Neutral, slashing price target from $519 to $276, citing mounting AI competition (Perplexity Tax, Chime Tax) threatening TurboTax and long-term growth; shares fell ~6.86%

Announced $80B equity offering — first stock issuance since 2005 — to fund AI infrastructure including $10B Berkshire Hathaway investment; dilution fears drove shares down ~3.5% as company doubled 2026 capex guidance to $180-190B

Beat quarterly earnings but issued cautious forward guidance, underperforming the broader tech rally; shares fell ~4.5% as CEO defended the SaaS model against AI disruption fears; stock is down ~30% YTD
Arete upgraded to Buy from Neutral, raising price target to $735 from $614, citing flexible cost structure, subscription growth momentum, and internal AI progress ahead of peers

Mizuho downgraded to Neutral from Outperform; while acknowledging Okta is positioned for agentic AI, analysts cited timing and magnitude of AI security uplift as "big question marks"; price target raised to $125

Secured a global supply agreement with a leading hyperscale data center operator to provide backup power generators; shares jumped ~5.9% to a new 52-week high; stock is up 101% YTD on data center power demand

BNP Paribas initiated coverage with Outperform and $192 price target, calling CoreWeave one of the most "strategically important" companies in the AI infrastructure ecosystem and a key GPU cloud beneficiary

Wedbush upgraded to Outperform from Neutral, raising price target to $19 from $12, citing governance transformation, Starboard Value activist involvement, and an emerging AI travel-search narrative as underappreciated catalysts

Piper Sandler double-downgraded to Underweight from Overweight, slashing price target to $3 from $23, after company discontinued lead drug pociredir for sickle cell disease following FDA concerns about secondary hematologic malignancies (rare cancers)
